ValidationRule.description: FW-02 AC2 (IRM_Touch_Level_Classification_SDD): Booking Verification is a mandatory gate for Framework Parent Opportunities. A Framework Parent cannot move to Booked (Closed Won) unless it is coming directly from Booking Verification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity", ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification")), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Framework Parent Opportunities must pass through Booking Verification before moving to Booked (Closed Won).
